title: Solving Minecraft's Storage Problem
description:
We're gonna be talking about the COPPER GOLEM and trying to figure out the best ways to utilise it's item sorting abilities. In this video we explore the finer nuances in making a functional storage and some of the minor decisions needed to make a storage system synergise well with the new copper golem's sorting capabilities.
